## Lifecycle Review

The four pure operations conform to the normative contract. Creation verifies the complete package and roster before constructing a bounded frozen session (`src/specialist-run-session.ts:144-244`, `src/specialist-run-session.ts:466-503`; authenticated snapshots at `docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/f4f91a373dd7f8028ec5d592e89c75f0027245c3/inputs/source-snapshots/src/specialist-run-session.ts`). Restore bounds raw input before parsing, rejects invalid closed state, revalidates the domain-separated digest and external package binding, canonically decodes every raw handoff, reverifies V11 semantics, enforces pass-only transitive dependency closure, and reconstructs the canonical value (`src/specialist-run-session.ts:302-457`, `src/specialist-run-session.ts:506-539`).

Recording applies the required precedence: prior-session validation, bounded raw verification, exact replay, conflicting-settlement rejection, terminal-route rejection, transitive dependency eligibility, canonical insertion, aggregate bound, detachment, and freeze (`src/specialist-run-transition.ts:151-223`; snapshot under the same run root at `inputs/source-snapshots/src/specialist-run-transition.ts`). Inspection derives every-agent status, manifest-resolved eligible contracts, exact accepted evidence, terminal routing, and complete-roster readiness without host-effect claims (`src/specialist-run-inspection.ts:153-246`, `src/specialist-run-inspection.ts:277-409`; corresponding authenticated snapshot under `inputs/source-snapshots/src/specialist-run-inspection.ts`). Integration readiness requires roster cardinality equality and an accepted `pass` for every selected blueprint (`src/specialist-run-inspection.ts:306-310`).

Canonical evidence ordering now uses `requirementId` as the primary identity and the complete closed tuple as tie-breakers (`src/specialist-run-inspection.ts:108-150`). The counterordered regression proves this independently of correlated criterion IDs (`test/specialist-run-inspection.test.mjs:52-57`, `test/specialist-run-inspection.test.mjs:376-392`; authenticated snapshot at `inputs/source-snapshots/test/specialist-run-inspection.test.mjs`). Accepted rows, agents, contracts, routes, artifacts, evidence, and next-action IDs are all normalized with ordinal comparison.

Dependency behavior is differentially checked across root, chain, diamond, fan-out, fan-in, disconnected, and complete DAGs (`test/specialist-run.test.mjs:342-491`). Independent valid arrival permutations converge (`test/specialist-run.test.mjs:493-535`), fresh-process restore preserves canonical semantics (`test/specialist-run.test.mjs:537-641`), and every non-`pass` route remains terminal and ineligible for fan-in (`test/specialist-run-transition.test.mjs:178-207`, `test/specialist-run-inspection.test.mjs:459-504`). The four operations also have a first-use no-filesystem-read regression (`test/specialist-run-foundation.test.mjs:259-277`).

## Resource Proof

The corrected aggregate fixture creates and verifies a complete 16-agent package, constructs sixteen valid 1,048,576-byte handoffs with exact 1,398,104-character canonical base64 rows, records them in forward and reverse orders, restores the final session, reinspects it, and proves identical integration-ready values (`test/specialist-run.test.mjs:948-1033`). Constituent ceilings prove the maximum session remains below both the 64 MiB raw restore boundary and 128 MiB canonical safeguard, while inspection remains below its 64 MiB safeguard (`test/specialist-run.test.mjs:1035-1072`). Exact raw-handoff and raw-session boundaries pass, and one-unit-over inputs fail without truncation (`test/specialist-run.test.mjs:1075-1137`).

## Canonical Evidence

The exact receipt at original path `docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/inputs/canonical-gates/f4f91a373dd7f8028ec5d592e89c75f0027245c3/canonical-gate-receipt.json`, snapshotted under this run at `inputs/canonical-gate/canonical-gate-receipt.json`, binds the candidate commit and tree, reports unchanged clean tracked state, exact source materialization, exit code 0, and `npm.cmd run verify` result `pass`. Its authenticated stdout records 408 tests passed with zero failures, including the corrected canonical-ordering, aggregate, recovery, routing, dogfood, package, and installed-consumer paths. The V12 dogfood additionally authenticates real implementation evidence, records the exact revision-4 pass handoff, restores and reinspects the immutable session, reports byte-identical replay, and keeps all runtime and integration effects external (`scripts/run-v12-dogfood.mjs:1061-1295`; authenticated snapshot under `inputs/source-snapshots/scripts/run-v12-dogfood.mjs`).

## Outcome

`pass`. Lifecycle correctness, deterministic recovery, canonical evidence ordering, aggregate resource proof, dependency eligibility, exact fan-in, routing, and immutability are release-ready for this exact candidate. This scoped pass does not establish complete R2 roster readiness or perform hosted CI, integration, merge, or memory closeout.
